headline: President Clinton changed the rules for an advisory committee that gives the government advice on computing and information technology.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13035, which set up the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee. That committee advises the federal government on computing, communications, and information technology. No summary was provided, so the exact changes this order made to the committee are not clear from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee
who_it_affects.how: The rules that govern their committee were changed in some way.
